correctness.rationale: All 495 four-subsets and 3502 nonempty faces are reconstructed from an explicit 30-edge graph, with 285 facets. A matched Hasse orientation is fully acyclic; exact arithmetic gives 1 degree-zero, 6 degree-six and 21 degree-seven Morse critical cells, with an integral 6x21 boundary of Smith invariants [1,0,0,0,0,0]. Hurewicz identifies the degree-six attaching maps; the unit invariant splits one 6/7 pair, leaving five six-spheres and twenty seven-spheres. Independent explicit subset enumeration confirms the face vector and Euler characteristic.

value.rationale: A canonical regular polyhedral graph is considered at the first next threshold beyond an already studied exact-graph three-cut case. The complete integral homotopy classification exposes simultaneous sixth- and seventh-dimensional homology and, therefore, a concrete non-shellability obstruction for a pure seven-dimensional 4-cut complex. Neither the published definition nor prior Betti/Euler estimates determine this mixed wedge.
